_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. All fields are optional.
_stratz_comment: Free API token from https://stratz.com/api — enables real synergy + counter data. Leave blank to use OpenDota fallback.
_steam_comment: Optional. Your OpenDota account ID (Steam64 minus 76561197960265728). Find it at https://www.opendota.com — your profile URL ends with it. If you set a Stratz token, your ID is decoded from it automatically.
_rank_comment: Filter win rate data by rank. Options: all, herald, guardian, crusader, archon, legend, ancient, divine, immortal
_weights_comment: Must sum to 1.0. Increase counter weight for matchup-heavy metas.
